Return named list with hexcodes RIVM palette

ro_color_palette.Rd



Usage

ro_color_palette(palette_name)

Arguments

palette_name

one of:

  • "full": all 18 RIVM colors (full color, 100% tint)

  • "categorical": best palette for visualizing categories (no variation in tint, good contrast differences)

  • "gender_con": gender conventional

  • "gender_unc": gender unconventional

  • "greys": all 7 grey tints

Value

named vector with hex color codes

Dependencies

  • ro_color

See also

Other ggplot2: get_color_palette(), ro_check_if_font_available(), ro_color(), ro_color_categorical(), ro_color_seq(), ro_color_seq_named(), ro_color_validate(), ro_get_color_palette(), ro_gg_create_palette(), ro_show_colors(), ro_show_colors_get_df()

Other ggplotly: ro_check_if_font_available(), ro_color(), ro_color_categorical(), ro_color_seq(), ro_color_seq_named(), ro_get_color_palette()

Other plotly: ro_check_if_font_available(), ro_color(), ro_color_categorical(), ro_color_seq(), ro_color_seq_named(), ro_get_color_palette()

Examples

ro_color_palette("categorical")
#>        hemelblauw        donkergeel        robijnrood      paars_tint90 
#>         "#007bc7"         "#ffb612"         "#ca005d"         "#552c6f" 
#> mintgroen_tint110            oranje             groen       donkerbruin 
#>         "#6abda4"         "#e17000"         "#39870c"         "#673327"
